description.en: Serves /v1/responses (including its WebSocket mode) and, through the core's conversion, /v1/chat/completions, /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits (the Responses image_generation tool; use the image model gpt-image-2) from your own ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI's logins: device code or Sign in with Codex. Only for the account owner's own use with their own ChatGPT subscription; do not pool several people's accounts or resell access (this violates OpenAI's terms). By default requests identify themselves truthfully as sup2api (originator: sup2api, User-Agent: sup2api-codex/<version>); both can be set per account or in the plugin settings. The plugin adds no x-codex-* headers of its own (it only passes on the client's x-codex-turn-state routing token), does not imitate the Codex CLI's TLS fingerprint and adds no Codex system prompt.
description.zh: 用你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅提供 /v1/responses（含 WebSocket 模式），并经核心转换提供 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/images/generations 和 /v1/images/edits（Responses 的 image_generation 工具；生图模型写 gpt-image-2）；通过 Codex CLI 的登录方式授权：设备码登录或 Sign in with Codex。仅用于账号所有者用自己的 ChatGPT 订阅自用；不得把多人账号做成号池对外出售（违反 OpenAI 条款）。请求默认如实标明来源为 sup2api（originator: sup2api，User-Agent: sup2api-codex/<版本>），两者都可以在账号上或插件设置中自定义。插件不自己加 x-codex-* 头（只转交客户端带来的 x-codex-turn-state 路由令牌）、不仿 Codex CLI 的 TLS 指纹，也不注入 Codex 系统提示词。

description.en: Your own ChatGPT subscription, authorized with the Codex device code login. Requests go to the ChatGPT Codex backend and use your plan's Codex usage. Own use only; pooling or reselling accounts is not allowed.
description.zh: 你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅，用 Codex 设备码登录授权。请求发往 ChatGPT 的 Codex 后端，消耗你套餐的 Codex 用量。仅限自用，不得做成号池或转售。

description.en: Your own ChatGPT subscription, authorized with the Codex CLI's browser sign-in (Sign in with Codex). Requests go to the ChatGPT Codex backend and use your plan's Codex usage. Own use only; pooling or reselling accounts is not allowed.
description.zh: 你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅，用 Codex CLI 的浏览器登录（Sign in with Codex）授权。请求发往 ChatGPT 的 Codex 后端，消耗你套餐的 Codex 用量。仅限自用，不得做成号池或转售。

description.en: Run the device code and Sign in with Codex authorizations that create or re-authorize ChatGPT (Codex) accounts
description.zh: 执行设备码登录与 Sign in with Codex 授权，用于新建或重新授权 ChatGPT（Codex）账号

label.en: Use the official ChatGPT (Codex) usage resets
label.zh: 使用 ChatGPT（Codex）官方用量重置次数

description.en: List a ChatGPT (Codex) account's official usage resets and spend one to reset its used-up usage windows. Spending a reset uses up one of the account's resets granted by OpenAI and cannot be undone
description.zh: 查看 ChatGPT（Codex）账号的官方用量重置次数，并使用一次来重置已用满的用量窗口。使用会消耗该账号由 OpenAI 发放的一次重置次数，且不可撤回

confirm.en: Spend 1 official ChatGPT (Codex) usage reset of this account (the one that expires first) and clear its current usage at once? It cannot be taken back; nothing is spent when no window can be reset.
confirm.zh: 消耗该账号 1 次 ChatGPT（Codex）官方重置次数（优先用最早过期的），立即清零当前用量？用掉后不能撤回；没有可重置的窗口时不扣次数。

reason.en: Register the ChatGPT (Codex) account types (device code, Sign in with Codex) for the built-in openai platform
reason.zh: 为内置 openai 平台注册 ChatGPT（Codex）账号类型（设备码登录、Sign in with Codex）

reason.en: After an official usage reset succeeds, clear the automatic disable and cool-down this plugin set on the account because a usage window was used up
reason.zh: 官方用量重置成功后，清除本插件因用量窗口用满而对账号设置的自动停用与冷却

reason.en: Keep the short-lived authorization sessions (device code; Sign in with Codex's PKCE verifier and state) between the console's calls, cache each account's remaining official usage resets so the account list does not ask ChatGPT on every refresh
reason.zh: 在控制台的多次调用之间保存短期授权会话（设备码；Sign in with Codex 的 PKCE verifier 与 state），缓存每个账号剩余的官方用量重置次数，使账号列表刷新时不必每次询问 ChatGPT

reason.en: Let only one device code poll at a time read and update an authorization session, so two concurrent polls (two tabs or two nodes) never both spend the single-use code; likewise let only one usage reset of an account run at a time, so a double click never spends two resets
reason.zh: 同一时间只允许一次设备码轮询读写授权会话，避免两次并发轮询（两个标签页或两个节点）都去使用一次性授权码；同理同一账号同一时间只允许一次用量重置，避免重复点击消耗两次

reason.en: Authorization endpoints the account form calls (device code start/poll, Sign in with Codex start/exchange; the core sends their requests to OpenAI through the proxy chosen in the account form) and the official usage reset endpoints (list, spend, cached counts)
reason.zh: 账号表单调用的授权端点（设备码开始/轮询、Sign in with Codex 开始/换取；它们发往 OpenAI 的请求由核心经账号表单选择的代理发送）与官方用量重置端点（查询、使用、缓存次数）

reason.en: The account form (CodexAuthForm) that runs the device code and Sign in with Codex flows, the official usage reset decoration and detail tab of the accounts (CodexResetBadge, CodexResetTab), and the settings form (CodexSettings)
reason.zh: 执行设备码登录与 Sign in with Codex 流程的账号表单（CodexAuthForm），账号的官方重置次数装饰、详情标签页（CodexResetBadge、CodexResetTab），以及设置表单（CodexSettings）
